name: ax-engineer-roadmap
description: Practical AX Engineer roadmap in Korean and English

scripts.check:docs: node scripts/check-links.mjs && node scripts/check-roadmap.mjs && node scripts/check-public-cases.mjs && npm run check:hiring
scripts.check: npm run check:docs && npm run check:cases && npm run check:copy && npm run check:version && npm run check:readme
scripts.test:python: python3 -m unittest discover -s case-studies/beauty-d2c-voc/tests -p 'test_*.py' -v && python3 case-studies/beauty-d2c-voc/pipeline/run_pipeline.py --verify-committed && python3 case-studies/beauty-d2c-voc/pipeline/approval_workflow.py --verify-committed
scripts.validate: npm run check && npm run test:research && npm run test:hiring && npm run test:readme && npm run test:python && npm run audit
scripts.verify: npm run bootstrap && npm run validate
